# Git standards

Keep history and review scoped to an explainable change.

| Task                    | Read                              |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Prepare a commit        | [Commits](commits.md)             |
| Open or update a review | [Pull requests](pull-requests.md) |

Identity: `bytefarm/git`. Content version: `0.1.0`. Authorization, branch protection, release workflows, and repository tooling are defined by the consuming repository.
